context: Checks the sqlite category workflow: category choice, rg validation, prepared-statement refactor and verification via quick commands.

checklist.name: Names the category
checklist.description: States the work falls under the SQLite and security categories before implementing

checklist.name: Runs the rg check
checklist.description: Runs `rg -n "query\(|prepare\(" src` to list query call sites

checklist.name: Flags the interpolated query
checklist.description: Identifies the concatenated `users.ts` query as flagged

checklist.name: Leaves safe query alone
checklist.description: Does not rewrite the fixed input-free query without reason

checklist.name: Uses db.prepare
checklist.description: Refactors the flagged call to `db.prepare` with a `?` placeholder

checklist.name: Binds the value
checklist.description: Passes `name` as a bound argument rather than interpolating it

checklist.name: No interpolation remains
checklist.description: No string concatenation or template interpolation remains in any query

checklist.name: Refactors before merging
checklist.description: Completes the refactor before suggesting a merge

checklist.name: Runs bun test
checklist.description: Verifies with `bun test` using the Quick Commands

checklist.name: Prepared statements for user input
checklist.description: States that queries with user-controlled input must use prepared statements
